evals.prompt: Audit the last 30 days of traffic for ameyachopade/gitlytics, explain what drove any spike, and tell me if visitors are actually cloning the repo.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_repo_traffic (or explains scoped API key setup if unauthenticated), computes unique visitor share and clone-to-visitor ratio, identifies top referrers/paths, and outputs the structured 4-section report.
assertions: Never asks the user to paste a raw GitHub PAT into chat
Computes and interprets clone-to-visitor ratio and referrer breakdown
Uses the 4-section report structure (Executive Summary, Traffic & Referrer Diagnostics, Health & Growth Actions, Data Retention Check)

evals.prompt: I keep losing my GitHub traffic history after 2 weeks. How do I archive it automatically and securely?
evals.expected_output: Provides safe archiving options using GitHub Actions (ameyachopade/gitlytics-github-traffic-automation@v1.2.0), local gitlytics sync with env var token, or Gitlytics Cloud.
assertions: Uses environment variables or GitHub Actions Secrets instead of hardcoded tokens
Offers concrete setup steps for GitHub Action and local CLI sync

evals.prompt: Check the AI health scorecard and star growth trajectory for ameyachopade/gitlytics and recommend my top 3 priorities.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_ai_health_analysis and get_public_star_history, synthesizes health score, milestone projection, and 3 prioritized recommendations.
assertions: Uses cached get_ai_health_analysis instead of wasting LLM quota
Includes current stars and next milestone projection from get_public_star_history
